messages:
raj: Heads up — seeing ~15 pods stuck Pending in ap-southeast1. Scheduler logs show a prebind handoff failure and a couple of node-level kernel panics on gpu-az2-11. Pods are affinity'd to the small-gpu flavor so they keep getting requeued.
elaine: ugh. can you paste the scheduler error and a node dmesg/snippet? :thinking:
raj: sure — here's the core scheduler error and a short node log excerpt:
```
E0312 10:12:01.123456 1 binder.go:213] prebind handoff failed: cannot move lease: lease owner mismatch (owner=node/gpu-az2-11, expected=node/gpu-az2-09)
I0312 10:12:01.123789 1 requeue.go:45] pod myjob-37 requeued for prebind
```
```
[  102.345678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:82:00): 79, pid=24685 in nvcpu_page_fault
[  102.346000] Kernel panic - not syncing: NVRM: GPU hung
[  102.346100] Rebooting in 10 seconds...
```
ashok: That looks familiar — when the node's GPU driver panics during attach, kubelet restarts mid-prebind. Our prebind controller tries to move the lease and sometimes races, leaving the pod with a stale prebind state. The scheduler then sees the pod affinity to small-gpu and keeps trying the same cohort -> fragmentation + evictions.
raj: also seeing warm-pool fragmentation metrics spike (warm_pool_hit_rate down, small-gpu islands with 1-2 stranded allocations). Costs going up due to repeated reschedules.
elaine: Quick triage: 1) cordon/drain the affected node(s) 2) increase prebind timeout to avoid mid-handshake moves 3) patch prebind controller to check kubelet heartbeat before claiming lease. Can we do a hotfix rollout for the timeout first? :+1:
ashok: i'll push a config change to bump prebindTimeout from 5s -> 12s and open an MR for the additional heartbeat check. Rolling to canary in ap-southeast1 only. Also suggest adding a short backoff on requeues for affinity-heavy pods to avoid hot-looping.
raj: doing cordon+drain on gpu-az2-11 now. kubelet logs show node came back after reboot but pods stayed in Pending (stale lease). I'll force-delete the stuck pods if they don't rebind in 60s.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0312-0457 — "ap-southeast1 prebind race + GPU kernel panic causing Pending pods". Pager notified: eng-platform, oncall.
elaine: good. followups: - add a metric for prebind-handshake-duration - set a small-gpu placement fallback to any-compatible when backfills fail 3x in 2m - run a one-off kernel-driver upgrade on that AZ after drain
raj: noted. will update thread when warm-pool metrics recover or if forced delete needed. :wave:
